parser_findings: The quality gate accepts required headings as exact uppercase lines with optional markdown heading markers.
The initial v6 CLI answers produced content and final messages but missed the exact heading contract.
The repair prompt now names all six exact headings on separate lines and requires at least 12 numbered items under the first four categories.
The x2 build candidate should add a launch-side prompt-preflight card so future prompts preserve exact heading contracts before runners start.

x2_build_candidate.name: cli_heading_contract_preflight
x2_build_candidate.purpose: Prevent elaborate-but-unclassifiable CLI responses by emitting a status-only heading contract before each CLI launch.
